title: Explicit complex square of additive functors
statement: Given a natural isomorphism F G ≅ F′ G′ of composite additive functors between preadditive categories, there is a natural isomorphism between their iterated cochain-complex functors. Its component is the original natural isomorphism applied degreewise.

proof.text: Use Mathlib NatIso.mapHomologicalComplex on the ordinary square, with an explicit result type retaining the two iterated complex functors. The ordinary and iterated complex functors have definitionally equal objects, differentials and maps. No composition with an auxiliary identity comparison is constructed. Unfolding the wrapper proves mapComplexSquare_hom by reflexivity.

proof_origin.place: Tag 010V, functorial construction of complexes; explicit construction and proof by V1

from.place: Explicit complex square of additive functors

lean.statement:
def mapComplexSquare
    {C D D' E : Type*} [Category C] [Category D] [Category D'] [Category E]
    [Preadditive C] [Preadditive D] [Preadditive D'] [Preadditive E]
    (F : C ⥤ D) (G : D ⥤ E) (F' : C ⥤ D') (G' : D' ⥤ E)
    [F.Additive] [G.Additive] [F'.Additive] [G'.Additive]
    (e : F ⋙ G ≅ F' ⋙ G') :
    F.mapHomologicalComplex (.up ℤ) ⋙ G.mapHomologicalComplex (.up ℤ) ≅
      F'.mapHomologicalComplex (.up ℤ) ⋙ G'.mapHomologicalComplex (.up ℤ)
